purpose: Register admissible pre-2015 or event-independent source evidence for hydrologic identity and outlet-resolution preparation without freezing an outlet cell or basin geometry from cartographic labels alone.

evidence: The report names San Antonio de Pedregal and Quirio as separate quebradas in Chosica.
Its pre-2015 satellite figure labels Quebrada Quirio and Quebrada Pedregal separately.

sources.title: Zonificacion Sismica-Geotecnica del Area Urbana de Chosica
evidence: The report identifies Quirio, Pedregal, Corrales, Libertad and Carosio as major quebradas on the right bank of the Rimac in the study area.
Figure 17 describes Quebrada Corrales crossing the Carretera Central near km 32 and reaching the Rimac River.
The pre-2015 cartography distinguishes Corrales from Carosio; Rayos de Sol is therefore not treated as an automatically independent drainage unit without contradictory pre-unblind evidence.

sources.institution: Universidad Nacional Mayor de San Marcos - IIGEO
sources.title: Flujos de detritos y dispersores de energia en la torrentera Juan Carossio Chosica - Lima
evidence: The pre-event article identifies Juan Carossio as a distinct torrent/drainage and states that its lower limit delivers to the Rimac River.

sources.title: Estudio de riesgo de la quebrada Pedregal - Chosica
evidence: The institutional repository confirms a dedicated Pedregal risk study exists and exposes a downloadable document locator.
sources.note: Do not upgrade to pre-2015 admissible evidence until publication date/version is independently established from the document itself or archival metadata.

conclusion: Hydrologic identity ambiguity is reduced for the five Chosica-side targets without consulting the sealed 2015 territorial outcome. No outlet cell or basin polygon is frozen by this evidence register; D8/source-cell resolution remains mandatory before morphometry and basin-weighted IMERG extraction.
